bugs.title: Four S/Z rotation states are not canonical SRS states
bugs.detail: The common orientation probe compared every one of the 28 piece/orientation coordinate sets after normalization. `S2`, `Z1`, `Z2`, and `Z3` differ from the Guideline matrices, changing rotation pivots/placement behavior even though the kick table itself is present.

bugs.title: Mini T-spins are not distinguished
bugs.detail: The engine tracks T-spins as a boolean and awards the full-spin table.

bugs.title: The game-over overlay is visible during active play
bugs.detail: Immediately after reload the engine status is `Playing` and the element has `hidden=true`, but computed CSS reports `display:flex`; the stylesheet's `.board-message` rule overrides the HTML hidden presentation. This was reproduced at desktop and mobile sizes.

entries.summary: Four S/Z rotation states are not SRS; game-over overlay shows during play
No confirmed bugs; tests skip kicks, lock delay and advanced scoring

bugs.title: Combo points are multiplied by the level twice
bugs.detail: At level two with one prior consecutive clear, a single should award `100×2 + 50×1×2 = 300`. [`awardLineScore`](luna-pi/src/game.ts) adds an already level-scaled combo bonus to `base`, then multiplies all of `base` by the level, awarding 400. The committed audit probe reproduces the over-award.

entries.summary: Combo bonus is multiplied by the level twice

bugs.title: Stale lock timing can lock an airborne piece after a ledge move
bugs.detail: Reproduction: let a piece become grounded on a small support, wait close to 500 ms, then move it sideways so it can fall. `move`/`rotate` update `groundedAt` rather than clearing it when the piece becomes airborne; the animation loop can call `lock()` from the stale timestamp before gravity moves the piece. The isolated engine/source probe reproduced the stale state and the browser-loop lock path.

bugs.title: Mini T-spins are not distinguished
bugs.detail: [`isTSpin`](sol-codex/src/game.ts) is binary and all recognized spins use the full table.

entries.summary: Piece can lock in mid-air after a ledge move; no mini T-spins

bugs.title: Mini T-spins are not distinguished
bugs.detail: Reproduction: construct a valid mini T-spin position, make rotation the final action, and lock it. [`isTSpin`](sol-omp/src/game.ts) returns only a boolean and [`applyScoring`](sol-omp/src/game.ts) uses the full T-spin table, so a mini receives full-T-spin treatment.

entries.summary: No mini T-spins; sparse test suite

bugs.title: A piece can lock while airborne after moving off a ledge
bugs.detail: Reproduction: ground a piece on a narrow support, move it sideways into empty space, then advance time beyond the 500 ms delay. `move()` resets the timer but leaves `grounded` true, so `update()` locks the piece without rechecking whether it can descend. The isolated engine probe reproduced this directly.

bugs.title: Guideline scoring is substantially incomplete
bugs.detail: [`game.ts`](deepseek-pi/src/game.ts) awards drop points and the basic single/double/triple/Tetris table only; it has no T-spin, back-to-back, combo, or perfect-clear scoring.

bugs.title: The narrow layout overflows horizontally
bugs.detail: At a 390 px viewport, `documentElement.scrollWidth` was 501 px and both side panels were clipped off-screen rather than reflowing.

entries.summary: Piece can lock in mid-air after a ledge move; basic scoring only

bugs.title: Moving a grounded piece prevents normal timed locking
bugs.detail: [`resetLockDelay`](beam/src/game.ts) stores `Date.now()`, but `updateLockDelay` receives `requestAnimationFrame`/`performance.now()` time. After a grounded move the lock timestamp is about 10¹² ms larger than the comparison clock. The piece remains unlocked even after a simulated nine-second wait.

bugs.title: Scoring uses a classic table and omits required modern scoring
bugs.detail: Normal clears award 40/100/300/1200 instead of 100/300/500/800 at the initial level multiplier. Soft-drop points are returned but ignored, and no T-spin, B2B, combo, or perfect-clear scoring exists. This is one grouped scoring deduction.

bugs.title: Narrow-screen panels are clipped
bugs.detail: Document width is 467 px at 390 px, with the hold canvas beginning at x≈−77.

bugs.title: A stray `EOF` marker is visibly rendered
bugs.detail: It appears after the closing HTML and creates an extra flex item on desktop.

entries.summary: Lock timer mixes two clocks; classic scoring table

bugs.title: L rotation state 2 changes the piece's shape
bugs.detail: [`SHAPES.L[2]`](cat-jam/src/game/pieces.ts) is a J-shaped orientation rather than the canonical L state. The common coordinate probe finds exactly `L2` mismatching.

bugs.title: Advanced scoring is missing
bugs.detail: The engine scores normal clears and combos but has no T-spin classification/scoring, back-to-back state, or perfect-clear bonus. A single-line perfect clear awards 100 rather than 900. These omissions are grouped into one scoring-feature deduction.

bugs.title: The narrow layout overflows
bugs.detail: At a 390 px viewport, document width is 538 px and the hold/next panels extend beyond the right edge.

entries.summary: Malformed L rotation state; no T-spin, B2B or perfect-clear scoring

bugs.title: No perfect-clear bonus under the benchmark's scoring profile
bugs.detail: An I piece completing a single-line perfect clear at zero drop distance awards 100 rather than 900. `scorePlacement` has no empty-board/perfect-clear branch.

bugs.title: Supporting panels overflow on narrow screens
bugs.detail: At 390 px, document width is 570 px; hold is at x=−150 and next at x=415. The main board fits, but important state is off-screen.

entries.summary: No perfect-clear bonus; side panels overflow on phones

bugs.title: The browser implementation does not start
bugs.detail: [`src/main.ts`](nemotron/src/main.ts) and its imports omit `.js` extensions. `tsc` preserves those specifiers, while the declared `http-server` returns 404 for `/dist/game` and `/dist/render`. The page remains empty, controls do nothing, and score stays zero.

bugs.title: Piece states and kick data are not SRS
bugs.detail: Twelve orientation states fail after accounting for the different piece origins; the I piece has copied non-I-style kicks instead of its required offsets.

bugs.title: Scoring is substantially incomplete
bugs.detail: Normal clears use 40/100/300/1200; T-spins, B2B, combos, and perfect clears are absent. Soft-drop scoring rounds each animation frame separately, so four 16 ms frames move a piece down without awarding a point.

bugs.title: Lock delay follows gravity ticks rather than elapsed grounded time
bugs.detail: A piece resting on the floor at level one does not lock at 501 ms; it locks on the first failed 816 ms gravity tick. Grounded movement/rotation also has no finite reset cap.

bugs.title: The narrow layout clips the board
bugs.detail: At 390 px, the board starts at x=−22, document width is 412 px, and the body hides overflow.

entries.summary: Does not start in the browser: imports lack .js extensions

bugs.title: Several shapes and counterclockwise kicks are not SRS
bugs.detail: The coordinate probe finds `L2`, `L3`, `T1`, `T2`, and `T3` mismatches; `L2` is even T-shaped. Counterclockwise rotation reverses a transition table and mirrors only X, producing incorrect Y kicks. These are grouped as one broken SRS feature.

bugs.title: The required ghost preview is structurally wrong
bugs.detail: [`ghostCells`](space-bunny/src/game.ts) returns the same Y coordinate for every cell, dropping each shape's local Y offset. An O ghost contains only two distinct coordinates instead of four, and other pieces become flat outlines that do not represent their landing shape. The same function drives rendering.

bugs.title: Scoring integration is substantially incorrect
bugs.detail: Full T-spins are classified as mini in ordinary three-corner cases; a final-kick result is accepted even with no occupied corners; no-clear placements break B2B; a level-two combo awards 400 rather than 300; and three held-soft-drop rows award one point rather than three. These related scoring defects receive one grouped deduction, not five deductions.

entries.summary: Non-SRS shapes and kicks, flattened ghost piece, scoring errors

bugs.title: Fixed-width layout does not fit a phone-sized viewport
bugs.detail: At 390×844, document width is 760 px; the 300 px board begins at x=230, so much of the board and next panel lie beyond the viewport.

entries.summary: Strongest tests and rules coverage; board does not fit a phone screen

bugs.title: Perfect-clear bonus is absent under the benchmark profile
bugs.detail: A zero-distance single-line perfect clear leaves an empty field but awards 100, not 900. The scoring method has no empty-board bonus branch.

bugs.title: The playfield collapses to 0×0 CSS pixels on a 390 px viewport
bugs.detail: Fixed side columns consume the available grid width and `canvas { max-width:100% }` shrinks the automatic center column to zero. The board is entirely invisible even though desktop play works. This is scored as one responsive-layout defect under the same rubric as earlier narrow-layout findings.

entries.summary: No perfect-clear bonus; board collapses to nothing on phones

bugs.title: Starting soft drop reuses accumulated normal-gravity time
bugs.detail: After 50 normal 16 ms updates at level one, an O remains at y=18. Pressing Down through Input and updating 1 ms moves it to y=34 and awards 16 points. The same gravity accumulator is consumed at the new 50 ms soft-drop interval without resetting or rescaling it. Playwright also observed 12 rows and points during a 120 ms Down hold.

bugs.title: Fixed-width layout clips the playfield on phones
bugs.detail: At 390×844, document width is 758 px. The board's 302×602 px border box starts at x=228 and ends at x=530; the next queue starts at x=554, outside the viewport. The fixed flex layout has no narrow-screen reflow.

entries.summary: Broad rules support; soft-drop timing jump and clipped phone playfield

bugs.title: Starting soft drop reuses accumulated normal-gravity time
bugs.detail: After fifty 16 ms updates at level one, send ArrowDown through the delivered input handler and advance 1 ms. The active O jumps sixteen rows and earns sixteen points, consuming the preceding 800 ms at the new 50 ms interval. Each normal step is below the browser frame cap. Movement and extra points are one timer-transition defect.

bugs.title: Fixed-width layout clips the playfield on phones
bugs.detail: At 390×844 in Chromium, document width is 752 px. The board border box is 304×604 at x=224, ending at x=528; next begins at x=552. Its fixed flex layout has no narrow-screen reflow, leaving much of the playfield outside the initial viewport.

entries.summary: Broad rules and strong tests; soft-drop timing jump and clipped phone playfield

bugs.title: Perfect-clear bonus is absent under the benchmark scoring profile
bugs.detail: A horizontal I at x=3,y=20 completes row 21 at zero drop distance. One row clears and the 22-row board is empty, but score is 100 rather than the benchmark profile’s 900. Neither Scorer.lock nor Game.lockPiece checks for an empty board.

bugs.title: Locking a whole piece above the skyline does not end the game
bugs.detail: Use a T,I source and blockers at (2,2),(3,3),(4,3). From the actual T spawn (3,1), rotate CW via SRS test 3 to (2,0), then CCW to spawn orientation at (2,0). The ghost is y=0. A zero-distance hard drop locks all four T cells in hidden rows 0–1, but status remains playing and the unblocked I spawns. Blocked-spawn top-out works; this specific lock-out path is absent.

bugs.title: Starting soft drop reuses accumulated normal-gravity time
bugs.detail: After fifty 16 ms updates at level one, send ArrowDown through the delivered input handler and advance 1 ms. The active O jumps sixteen rows and earns sixteen points, consuming the preceding 800 ms at the new 50 ms interval. Each normal step is below the browser frame cap. Movement and extra points are one timer-transition defect.

bugs.title: Supporting state overflows the phone viewport
bugs.detail: At 390×844 in Chromium, document width is 596 px. The 300×600 board remains visible at x=18, but the 240 px sidebar begins at x=340 and both hold and next canvases start at x=424. Their contents and right-aligned scores are outside the initial viewport.

entries.summary: No perfect-clear bonus or hidden lock-out; soft-drop timing jump and phone sidebar overflow

bugs.title: Advanced scoring is missing
bugs.detail: Legal full/mini rotation-to-lock fixtures award 0 with no clear and 100 for a single, versus full 400/800 and mini 100/200. Two Tetrises separated by a no-clear lock total 1600 instead of 2000 with B2B; a level-two single with a prior clear awards 200 instead of 300 with combo; a perfect-clear single awards 100 instead of 900. These absent scoring features receive one grouped major deduction.

bugs.title: A wholly hidden lock does not end the game
bugs.detail: With O,T,I and J stack cells (2,2),(3,3),(4,3), move O four columns left, hold T, rotate CW/CCW and move left twice. T legally reaches rotation 0,x=0,y=0, supported at ghost y=0. Hard drop locks all four cells above visible row 2, yet gameOver stays false and an unblocked I spawns. Only the stack is injected; public actions reach the hidden pose.

bugs.title: Starting soft drop reuses accumulated normal-gravity time
bugs.detail: Fifty 16 ms level-one updates leave O at y=2 with 800 ms accumulated. Enable soft drop and advance 1 ms: it jumps to y=18 and earns 16 points. The browser independently reproduces this through the real ArrowDown handler. Movement and extra points share one timing cause and deduction.
